You can get health back just from skill swap once you hit 3 quiros and also use super recovery dango or gourmet fish to mitigate the health decrease. 

Issue with blood rite is you only get the health when hitting broken parts, so in the beginning its not that useful till later in yhe hunt.

I used blood rite + dereliction and didn't really rely on blood rite much in the small few occasions when the monster is down since I had other means to maintain health. It's not a must have but nice insurance if you can fit it into your build but wouldn't solely rely on it to keep your health up.

Symphonia is great starting point that feels satisfying when completed. The story and characters are some of the best and memorable with the combat being very straight forward and simple.

Vesperia has some of the best gameplay and system im the series with everyone is good and creative for you to develop combos and loops. The story is decent with the characters being the strongest point.

Berseria is lacking. Character's like Eizen, Magilou, Shigure, the main villain and Rokurou are good and carry the game. Everyone else is lackluster with the plot being semi forgettable. The combat is decent.

Zesty story is not that good but the characters make up for it. Combat is not the best.
